title: Label-Efficient Defect Detection with Masked Patch Pretraining
method: Our approach, Masked Patch Pretraining (MPP), pretrains a ViT-S encoder by masking 60% of 16x16 patches and reconstructing them in pixel space on 200k unlabeled line images.
datasets: MVTec AD and VisA, plus 200k unlabeled images from our own inspection line.
metrics: Image-level AUROC and pixel-level PRO score.
main_result: With 50 labeled defects per class, MPP reaches 97.8 image AUROC on MVTec AD, matching a supervised baseline trained on 200 labels.
